description: A older woman with grey hair in a bun, wearing a black high-necked buttoned dress with lace cuffs, writes with a pen on a sheet of paper at a wooden table. An open book and a lit oil lamp sit beside her, and four or five dark-suited and dark-dressed people, including a bearded man and a young woman, watch over her shoulders in a dim room with gilt-framed portraits on the wall. The style is a dark, warm oil painting, edge to edge, with no visible legible text.
